title: Festbiss – Video-Ad 17 (DE) · „5 Gründe, Festbiss nicht zu kaufen“ – ironischer Clay-Animationsfilm
format: Stylized 3D stop-motion clay animation: a charming clay grandma at her cozy kitchen table and in a bistro, clay props (adhesive tube in bag, pocket, car, cabinet), sad talking food, clay cross-section models of a denture with gel on light blue, and the clay Festbiss tube. Reverse-psychology list format.
voice_note: Female VO (the grandma), German, warm, dry, ironic, a little cheeky. Address: Sie.
captions_note: White bold sans with a soft black shadow, 2–4 words, centered in the lower middle. S01: red header box top „5 Gründe, Festbiss NICHT zu kaufen“. From S02: thin progress bar at the top with five pills „GRUND 1 … GRUND 5“, the active one red – Grund 1: S02–S05 · Grund 2: S05 („Sie lieben weiches Essen“)–S11 · Grund 3: S11 („…überallhin mitzunehmen“)–S17 · Grund 4: S17 („…kontrollieren“)–S21 · Grund 5: S22–S31. Green round 60-day badge in S45.

shots.vo_line: sich darunter formt und für besseren Halt sorgt, kommen Sie vielleicht tatsächlich
shots.h3_prompt: A clay-sculpted cross-section model of a lower jaw in side three-quarter view: a sandy-beige porous bone block, a pink gum layer on top, a lower denture (white clay teeth on a pink base) sitting on it, and a thin glossy layer of glossy translucent amber-gold gel (honey-colored, slightly see-through) between the denture base and the gum. Plain light-blue background, soft studio light. Clay figures move in small stop-motion steps: the amber gel layer slowly spreads along the arch under the denture, which settles down onto it; static camera. The tube and box keep their exact shape and label, sharp and unchanged. One continuous shot from this exact first frame; keep the same people, faces, clothing, setting, background, lighting and colours for the whole clip. No new people, no extra hands. Nothing new enters the frame; the product's printed label stays exactly as in the first frame. Teeth, gums and dentures stay anatomically natural. Gentle natural motion, no morphing. The gel layer keeps exactly the size, colour and place it has in the first frame: it does not grow, swell, drip, melt, run or sink. The box and tube stay exactly where they are.
